info.title: Infrastructure Lifecycle Management API
info.description: Cluster registration and inventory API. OIDC ID tokens require configured issuer/audience and persisted organization membership. Bootstrap token accepted only on isolated development/loopback deployments. Agent requests use Ed25519 signatures over method, escaped path, cluster, key, Unix timestamp, nonce and SHA-256 body digest. HTTPS is mandatory outside isolated loopback development. No maintenance execution endpoints.

bootstrapBearer.description: Generated development-only global admin token; minimum 32 characters.

oidcBearer.description: OIDC ID token from the configured issuer and audience. Subject membership is looked up in PostgreSQL.

agentSignature.name: X-Kordex-Signature
agentSignature.description: Ed25519 signature as unpadded standard base64. Additional X-Kordex headers are required. See docs/agent-protocol.md.
